where.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM illustration_tag selected_tag WHERE selected_tag.illustration_id = i.id AND selected_tag.tag_id IN #{tagId})

AND (i.title LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR i.note LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR a.display_name LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR a.x_username LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(CONCAT('@', a.x_username)) LIKE LOWER(#{pattern}) ESCAPE '!' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM illustration_tag it JOIN tag t ON t.id = it.tag_id WHERE it.illustration_id = i.id AND t.name LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!'))

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM illustration i LEFT JOIN author a ON i.author_id = a.id

SELECT i.id AS illustration_id, i.title AS illustration_title, a.id AS author_id, a.display_name AS author_display_name, a.x_username AS author_x_username, cover_asset.id AS cover_asset_id, cover_asset.mime_type AS cover_mime_type, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM asset asset_count WHERE asset_count.illustration_id = i.id) AS asset_count, i.created_at AS illustration_created_at FROM illustration i LEFT JOIN author a ON i.author_id = a.id LEFT JOIN asset cover_asset ON cover_asset.id = ( SELECT candidate.id FROM asset candidate WHERE candidate.illustration_id = i.id ORDER BY candidate.sort_order ASC, candidate.id ASC LIMIT 1 )
ORDER BY i.created_at DESC, i.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT illustration_id, id, mime_type, sort_order FROM asset WHERE illustration_id IN #{illustrationId} ORDER BY illustration_id, sort_order ASC, id ASC
